details.race_name: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Guaranteed Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

selection_reason.summary: Keops Des Bordes is a very short-priced favourite for his hurdling debut after only one run in the last 22 months, a fourth in an Ayr bumper 197 days ago. Ronnie Russet won two bumpers, including an easy Newcastle success, before finishing close enough in a Grade 1 at Aintree to be a serious rival. Point winners Ocean Master and Lauvergnat add further depth, so the favourite's price asks a lot of unproven jumping and fitness.
selection_reason.counterargument: Keops Des Bordes won his point, ran well behind No Drama This End in a bumper, returned from a long absence with ability intact and represents Dan and Harry Skelton. Sporting Life makes him the selection and the strong market support may prove accurate.

details.race_name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Claiming Hurdle

selection_reason.summary: Pigeon House is around evens despite an inconsistent sequence containing two pulled-up runs and a 26-length defeat 15 days ago. Shallow River is rated 4 lb higher, has won over this course and distance and drops into claiming company with first-time blinkers. Blackwater Lilly also shaped better than the bare result over this course and distance last time, giving the favourite two plausible opponents.
selection_reason.counterargument: Pigeon House drops in class, has previously made all to win a two-mile claimer and may have too much speed for Shallow River. The opposition is unreliable too, so this is a moderate case rather than a strong one.
